mentions.name: Self-hosted Rust analytics tool
mentions.description: A self-hosted web analytics tool written in Rust that collects visitor data via a JavaScript beacon and by streaming Caddy access logs, built to replace the author's self-hosted Plausible and Umami.
mentions.problem: Replaces self-hosted Plausible and Umami analytics.
mentions.source_excerpt: I also completely got rid of self-hosted plausible and umami analytics, and replaced them with vibe-coded built-in-rust (c) analytics tool that relies on both js-beacon and streaming of caddy access.log.

evidence.value: I also completely got rid of self-hosted plausible and umami analytics, and replaced them with vibe-coded built-in-rust (c) analytics tool that relies on both js-beacon and streaming of caddy access.log.
